# Lossless_ANN_SNN_Conversion

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A quantization-aware technique that converts artificial neural networks to spiking neural networks with nearly zero accuracy loss. Critical for deploying pre-trained models on neuromorphic hardware without retraining, bridging the gap between conventional and spike-based computing.
